findings.title: Exposed Environment file with secrets
findings.evidence: HTTP 200, Content-Type 'text/plain', 77 bytes, content signature for 'Environment file with secrets' matched (values redacted).
findings.recommendation: Remove the file from the web root or deny access in the web server config; rotate any secrets that were exposed.

findings.title: CORS reflects arbitrary Origin with credentials
findings.evidence: Origin: https://evil.vulnscan.invalid -> Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://evil.vulnscan.invalid; Allow-Credentials: True
findings.recommendation: Validate Origin against a strict allow-list; never combine reflected origins with credentials.

findings.title: Path traversal indicator (OS file signature in response)
findings.evidence: Parameter 'file' with '../../../../../../etc/passwd' returned content matching the signature 'root:[x*!]?:0:0:'. (File contents are intentionally not stored in this report.)
findings.recommendation: Never build file paths from user input; map IDs to files via an allow-list, canonicalise the path and verify it stays inside the intended base directory.

findings.title: Possible SQL injection (MySQL error message)
findings.evidence: Appending "'" to 'id' produced a database error: "You have an error in your SQL syntax" (HTTP 500); the baseline response had no such error.
findings.recommendation: Use parameterised queries / prepared statements, validate input types, and show generic error pages.

findings.title: Reflected XSS: input echoed without HTML encoding
findings.evidence: Marker 'vsxc36debe9<b>' sent in 'q' was reflected unescaped in an HTML response (HTTP 200). Only a harmless marker was used.
findings.recommendation: Contextually HTML-encode all output, use an auto-escaping template engine and add a restrictive Content-Security-Policy.

findings.title: Exposed Git repository metadata
findings.evidence: HTTP 200, Content-Type 'text/plain', 21 bytes, content signature for 'Git repository metadata' matched (signature matched).
findings.recommendation: Remove the file from the web root or deny access in the web server config; rotate any secrets that were exposed.

findings.title: Login form transmits credentials over HTTP
findings.evidence: Form with password field (action=http://127.0.0.1:8081/login, method=POST) is not protected by TLS.
findings.recommendation: Serve the login page and the form action over HTTPS only and redirect all HTTP requests.

findings.title: POST form has no anti-CSRF token
findings.evidence: Form on http://127.0.0.1:8081/ (method=POST, fields: author, text) contains no field resembling a CSRF token.
findings.recommendation: Add a per-session unpredictable CSRF token validated on the server (or use the double-submit cookie pattern) and set SameSite=Lax/Strict on session cookies.

findings.title: POST form has no anti-CSRF token
findings.evidence: Form on http://127.0.0.1:8081/login (method=POST, fields: user, pass) contains no field resembling a CSRF token.
findings.recommendation: Add a per-session unpredictable CSRF token validated on the server (or use the double-submit cookie pattern) and set SameSite=Lax/Strict on session cookies.

findings.title: Open redirect via parameter
findings.evidence: HTTP 302 with Location: https://vulnscan-canary.invalid/redirect-test when 'next' was set to an external canary URL.
findings.recommendation: Only redirect to relative paths or to an allow-list of hosts; never trust a user-supplied URL.

findings.title: Site is served over HTTP instead of HTTPS
findings.evidence: Scheme of target is 'http' (expected for a local lab, critical for a production site). Credentials, cookies and content travel unencrypted.
findings.recommendation: Serve the whole site over HTTPS (TLS 1.2+), redirect HTTP to HTTPS with a 301 and enable HSTS.

findings.title: Directory listing enabled
findings.evidence: Response contains an 'Index of /' style listing of files.
findings.recommendation: Disable auto-indexing (Apache: Options -Indexes; nginx: autoindex off) and add an index file.

findings.title: Exposed phpinfo() page
findings.evidence: HTTP 200, Content-Type 'text/html; charset=utf-8', 90 bytes, content signature for 'phpinfo() page' matched (signature matched).
findings.recommendation: Remove the file from the web root or deny access in the web server config; rotate any secrets that were exposed.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy header missing
findings.evidence: Header 'Content-Security-Policy' absent on 10/10 HTML pages (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8081/).
findings.recommendation: Define a restrictive CSP (e.g. default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none') to limit the impact of XSS.

findings.title: Clickjacking protection missing (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)
findings.evidence: Header 'X-Frame-Options' absent on 10/10 HTML pages (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8081/).
findings.recommendation: Send 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' (or SAMEORIGIN) or CSP 'frame-ancestors'.

findings.title: Python traceback disclosed in response
findings.evidence: Signature 'Python traceback' matched: "Traceback (most recent call last)"
findings.recommendation: Disable debug mode, return generic error pages and log details server-side only.

findings.title: Version disclosed in 'Server' header
findings.evidence: Server: Apache/2.4.49 (Unix). Known issue hint (verify, may be back-ported): Apache httpd 2.4.49/2.4.50: CVE-2021-41773 / CVE-2021-42013 (path traversal, possible RCE).
findings.recommendation: Hide version banners (Apache: ServerTokens Prod; nginx: server_tokens off; PHP: expose_php=Off) and keep components patched.

findings.title: Version disclosed in 'X-Powered-By' header
findings.evidence: X-Powered-By: PHP/5.6.40. Known issue hint (verify, may be back-ported): PHP < 7.4 is end-of-life and no longer receives security fixes.
findings.recommendation: Hide version banners (Apache: ServerTokens Prod; nginx: server_tokens off; PHP: expose_php=Off) and keep components patched.

findings.title: Cookie 'PHPSESSID' set without HttpOnly flag
findings.evidence: Set-Cookie attributes seen: path
findings.recommendation: Add 'HttpOnly' so JavaScript (and therefore XSS payloads) cannot read the cookie.

findings.title: Cookie 'PHPSESSID' set without SameSite attribute
findings.evidence: Set-Cookie attributes seen: path
findings.recommendation: Add 'SameSite=Lax' (or Strict) to limit cross-site sending and reduce CSRF risk.

findings.title: External script loaded without Subresource Integrity
findings.owasp: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.evidence: https://cdn.example.com/lib.js has no 'integrity' attribute (included from http://127.0.0.1:8081/).
findings.recommendation: Add integrity="sha384-..." and crossorigin="anonymous" to third-party resources, or self-host them.

findings.title: Cookie 'PHPSESSID' set without Secure flag
findings.evidence: Set-Cookie: PHPSESSID=<redacted>; path
findings.recommendation: Add the 'Secure' attribute so the cookie is only sent over HTTPS.

findings.title: Cookie 'theme' set without Secure flag
findings.evidence: Set-Cookie: theme=<redacted>; path
findings.recommendation: Add the 'Secure' attribute so the cookie is only sent over HTTPS.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff missing
findings.evidence: Header 'X-Content-Type-Options' absent on 10/10 HTML pages (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8081/).
findings.recommendation: Send 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' to stop MIME-type sniffing.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy header missing
findings.evidence: Header 'Referrer-Policy' absent on 10/10 HTML pages (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8081/).
findings.recommendation: Send 'Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin' (or stricter).

findings.title: Cookie 'theme' set without HttpOnly flag
findings.evidence: Set-Cookie attributes seen: path
findings.recommendation: Add 'HttpOnly' so JavaScript (and therefore XSS payloads) cannot read the cookie.

findings.title: Cookie 'theme' set without SameSite attribute
findings.evidence: Set-Cookie attributes seen: path
findings.recommendation: Add 'SameSite=Lax' (or Strict) to limit cross-site sending and reduce CSRF risk.

not_tested.reason: Design flaws and business-logic abuse need understanding of intended behaviour; a generic scanner cannot judge them.

not_tested.category: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
not_tested.reason: Logging, alerting and incident response happen server-side and are invisible to a remote, read-only client. Review log configuration and alert rules manually.
SSRF needs an out-of-band callback server or a harmful internal target to confirm safely; this tool does not send such payloads.

limitations: Static HTML crawler: JavaScript-rendered single-page apps (e.g. Juice Shop) expose few links/forms.
Only GET parameters and GET forms are fuzzed by default (POST needs --allow-post).
No authentication, so everything behind a login is out of scope.
Blind/time-based SQLi, DOM-based XSS, IDOR and business-logic flaws are not detected.
Signature-based detection can miss custom error pages and may flag documentation pages that quote error text.
